source_locator: R2247: C08030022600, 經過, 麾下及友軍ノ行動概要, 12 October 1942 (PDF p. 41, 一〇―一二). R2242: 12 October 1942
current_activity: sunk by air attack off Savo Island while returning from the Cape Esperance reinforcement landing
notes: JACAR 8th Fleet October 經過 (C08030022600, PDF p. 41) dates 日進、千歳、秋月、夏雲 as landing artillery and 675 army troops on 12 October (一〇―一二, confirmed at high resolution, not 一〇―二二), and records 帰途空襲ニ依リ夏雲ト叢雲ヲ失フ. Cressman, 12 October 1942, states that an SBD sank Natsugumo off Savo Island. Confidence 0.7: JACAR (jacar) and Cressman (us_navy_nhhc) agree on the unit, the day, and the loss to air attack off Savo / in Ironbottom Sound (area). Murakumo is named in the same JACAR loss sentence; her existing 12 October claim (C13224) records the earlier survivor-rescue in Ironbottom Sound and is left unchanged, because Cressman places her later scuttling off New Georgia, a place the JACAR row does not name.
